scopeBasis.macos: Foliole 0.7.6 adds system-aware multilingual behavior across the desktop application, so the supported macOS package is required.
scopeBasis.windows: Foliole 0.7.6 adds system-aware multilingual behavior across the desktop application, so the supported Windows package is required.
scopeBasis.linux: Foliole 0.7.6 adds system-aware multilingual behavior across the desktop application, so the Linux Experimental package is required.
